Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options & VAT evidence (Greenline)

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the note and the template. TL;DR: we can support the three common delivery paths and send VAT info; below are tradeoffs and a suggested path so you can pick. I attached a sample Redwood invoice and our invoicing schema.

Delivery options (supported):
- Portal (recommended): single place for PDFs, CSV exports, per-invoice metadata, and historical VAT evidence attachments. Useful if you want easy search and self-serve re-issues.
- Email PDF: send to accounts-payable@greenline.com with PO in the subject line. Simpler but manual for AP reconciliation.
- SFTP / e-invoice (Peppol): we support SFTP push and can enable Peppol for certified trading partners — requires vendor setup on both sides and a profile exchange.

VAT & evidence: Our invoices include VAT/Tax ID, line-level tax, and country codes. If you need 'VAT certificate' attachments we can include them as a one-off per-entity; for ongoing evidence we can attach to portal records.

PO and auto-collection: We require a PO number on the invoice for non-card payments. We also support card-on-file for automated collection (merchant fees apply). If you'd like, we can scope a hybrid flow: portal for archiving and an email copy to AP for processing.

Suggested next steps:
1) Confirm your preferred delivery path (Portal / Email PDF / SFTP or Peppol).
2) Share the AP contact and the billing entity (legal name + VAT/EIN).
3) If Portal preferred: complete the onboarding form (link below) and we'll provision an account and attach sample VAT evidence.

I'll loop in Marissa (billing ops) and Karthik (tax/collection) to help finalize.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0102

Hi Alyssa — looping in with next steps from the billing team.

1) Portal onboarding: please fill the short intake here: https://redwood.app/onboarding/invoice-delivery-form?acct=GL-2028-019 — that will provision portal access and allow you to opt into Email CC copies as a migration step.

3) First invoice: we will generate the March 1 usage invoice and (a) email a PDF to accounts-payable@greenline.com and (b) make it visible in the portal by March 5.
